title: C482/2321/2022 of LOKESH MITTAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Criminal Miscellaneous Application No. 2321 of 2022
Lokesh Mittal ..... Applicant
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and Another .....Respondents
Mr. Prabhakar Joshi, Advocate for the Applicant
Mr. A.K. Sah, Deputy Advocate General assisted by Mrs. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder for
the State.
Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate for respondent no. 2
JUDGMENT
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J. (Oral)
The present C-482 Application, is a complaint case,
which has been instituted with a compounding application.
Precisely, the facts are that there in Criminal Case No. 2145 of
2022, 'State Vs. Lokesh Mittal' which stood instituted, as a
consequence of concluding of the investigation, to the set of
allegations, as levelled in FIR No. 0224 of 2021 dated
13.11.2021, whereby the present applicant was named accused
person for his alleged involvement of his in commission of
offence under Sections 409, 420 & 471 of IPC.
2. The matter was investigated upon and, thereafter, the
cognizance have been taken by the Court of Chief Judicial
Magistrate, Pithoragarh, by way of registration of Criminal Case
No. 2145 of 2022, 'State Vs. Lokesh Mittal'.
3. The applicant to the present C-482 Application, who is
represented by Mr. Prabhakar Joshi, has been duly identified by
him. Though, the complainant-respondent no. 2 is not present
today, but, since, the factum of exchange of an amount due, as
referred to in Para-3 of the Compounding Application, that the
applicant is willing to discharge his obligation of payment of

2
Rs.6.5 Lakhs to the respondent no. 2, is a fact which has not been
disputed by the counsel representing respondent no. 2.
4. The applicant's counsel has produced before this Court,
the said draft Bearing no. 953895829 dated 21.12.2022, as it is
been drawn in favour of Cholamandalam Investment and Finance
Co. Ltd. The present respondent no. 2 is representing the
aforesaid company in his official capacity, in drawing a
complaint proceedings against the present applicant.
5. In that view of the matter, since, the draft has been
presented before this Court, which has been drawn from the
branch of Indian Overseas Bank, Rudrapur Branch, the same is
being handed over to the counsel for respondent no. 2, who
would ensure in turn to hand it over to his client, within three
days from today.
6. The Bench Secretary is directed to obtain a xerox copy
of this bank draft along with the receipt by the counsel
representing respondent no. 2 and place the same on record.
7. Since, the applicant has discharged its liability and,
which is not a fact denied by the respondent's counsel, the
present C-482 application would stand disposed of as a
consequence thereto.
8. The proceedings of Criminal Case No. 2145 of 2022,
'State Vs. Lokesh Mittal', pending consideration before the
Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pithoragarh, would hereby
stand dropped.

3
9. As a consequence of today's order, resulting into a
dropping of proceedings, in view of the fact of the compound
composition of offence, the applicant who is presently
languishing in jail is directed to be released forthwith, without
any conditions to be imposed upon him, subject to the condition,
that he is not wanted in any other case.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
23.12.2022 PN/-
